title: Specify and implement upgrade boundary tests before corrections
outcome: Independent state-transition oracles expose current gaps before production changes and provide a fast local regression loop.
acceptance: Cases trace to the agreed transition document with explicit expected outcome and relevant full no-follow file-inventory oracles, independent of production classification.

Cover representative reachable crash boundaries and contradictory combinations: split original, equal original and candidate, absent or empty sidecars, partial and complete staging, foreign bytes, journal phases, path aliases and terminal rollback closure.

Existing test coverage is reused; missing cases are authored and their baseline pass or failure classified before related fixes. Small focused runs are recorded once; remaining platform and power-loss gaps are explicit.

blockers.detail: Historical acceptance criterion 3 needs a decision: retained V5/V7 evidence explicitly identifies some fixtures executed only after correction and a later reconstructed matrix baseline. Final tests pass, but cleanup cannot assert every missing case had a classified pre-fix baseline or retroactively manufacture it.

disposal_reason: Obsolete: its crash-boundary oracles target the coordinated prepare/activate/finalize/rollback upgrade state machine removed in 54285f2; the current migration is one-way export/import. Triage 2026-09-27, consultation Engram::Fable, Termal::Fable, Engram::Coder, unanimous.
